formation.note: No fetched source states a formation date.

intervals.label: ECHo-1k phase (medium-scale experiment, about 1 kBq of 163Ho)
intervals.note: Start: the June 2017 overview (open access, published 2017-06-20) calls ECHo-1k the 'present medium scale experiment'; the dates of the data taking are not stated. Evidence that data were acquired: a July 2021 paper analyses 'high statistics data acquired with the first phase of the ECHo experiment, ECHo-1k'. End: the January 2023 ECHo-100k paper says ECHo-1k 'paved the way for the current phase, ECHo-100k'.
intervals.quote: the strategies we have adopted to carry on the present medium scale experiment, ECHo-1K

intervals.label: ECHo-100k phase (aims at a sensitivity below 2 eV)
intervals.note: Start is the arXiv v1 date (2023-01-16) of the paper that calls ECHo-100k 'the current phase'; the true start is earlier and not dated. Open: the most recent source (September 2025, the ECHo-1k result) does not say whether ECHo-100k is taking data on 2026-10-26.
intervals.quote: The results of the first phase of the experiment, ECHo-1k, have paved the way for the current phase, ECHo-100k, which aims at a sensitivity below 2 eV on the effective electron neutrino mass.

name: ECHo Collaboration
notes: Name evidence: the ECHo collaboration page and the 2025 paper ('the Electron Capture in 163Ho collaboration, ECHo'). No roster or formation date was found.

summary.plain: The international collaboration (Heidelberg, Karlsruhe, Mainz and other institutes) that runs the ECHo neutrino-mass experiment.
summary.technical: ECHo Collaboration: Kirchhoff Institute for Physics (Heidelberg), KIT, Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz, MPI for Nuclear Physics, GSI, ISOLDE and other institutes named on the 2025 ECHo-1k paper; contact L. Gastaldo.
